District.reason: District Line: Severe delays between High Street Kensington and Richmond, and between Kensington(Olympia) and Upminster due to an earlier signal system failure and heat-related temporary speed restrictions. Tickets will be accepted London Buses, Mildmay Line, DLR, Elizabeth line, c2c and South Western Railway services. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Honor Oak Park, Forest Hill, Sydenham, Crystal Palace, Gipsy Hill, West Norwood, Tulse Hill and Streatham Hill.
